summary: Assembly Biosciences filed an 8-K reporting an underwritten registered offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The company issued 3,358,602 shares at $26.50 per share and 415,000 pre-funded warrants at $26.499 per warrant, with the underwriters' option exercised in full for 566,040 additional shares. Net proceeds were ~$107.4 million. Underwriters included Guggenheim Securities and UBS. The filing is a standard capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No other special-situation elements (acquisition, tender, etc.) are present. This is a routine securities offering under a shelf registration statement. What to watch: dilution impact; no meaningful risk-arb angle as it is an ordinary equity issuance.
